convergenceLemma.proof: Taylor majorization gives (n+m)!/n!*(1-t)^(-n-m-1); differentiated generating function sums to (m+k)!*20^-k*c^(-m-k-1). Compact normal convergence proves holomorphy and termwise differentiation.

picardConvergence.thresholdFromIndependentMajorantAudit: verify_majorant.py; norms and positivity remain hypotheses

requiredOriginalPremises.premise: Every actual A0/A1/forcing composition is bounded holomorphic on the same eta tube, including all integral paths and inverse/log/sqrt branches.
The actual native functions equal the functions supplying the Picard majorant norms; a finite approximant or operator declaration does not establish equality.
Every finite order n>=2 has finalized lower-order solutions, moments and cutoffs yielding forcing norms on the same radial interval.
Every original band, label, copy and Cartesian evaluation remains in that certified domain with its required W/M/S bounds.

blockers: Actual compatible B_rho coefficient norm Q must be proved from the authenticated recurrence and all captured inputs; producer declarations and previous PASS flags are insufficient.
The small eta tube rho/2 is distinct from the earlier quarter stadium; no extension between them is inferred.
Every unresolved radial argument needs its actual parameter or integral endpoint bound, including every occurrence scope.
Other inverse/log/sqrt branches and all A0/A1/forcing compositions still need a shared domain and uniform norm; natural subcall bounds alone do not prove Picard convergence.
